author: ProfessorUtonium
body:
IT'S BACK!

Maisosen!

Made By:
Tanpopo
NinjaBridge

Old Forum Post: https://avicus.net/forums/2a60312be

Why was this map discontinued?
It was because the Villagers that were on the spawn platform could not be accessed because of YML boundaries. This new version SHOULD fix that

What is so special about this map?
You Spawn with a Wooden Pickaxe! You need to collect as many emeralds as u can and gain pickaxes from villager vendors. Have spare Emeralds Lying around? Buy Speed Pots and Health Pots! You can also buy Blocks (Wooden Planks and Sand) as well as Some Special Gold Armor!

YML: http://pastebin.com/E0qaYTPc
Images: Some New Images (Anything Not shown and is shown in the old photos is the same thing): http://imgur.com/a/JUhaO
Old Images: http://imgur.com/a/QOqYU
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/?9f50mvcn5gpqvjr

You know how hard this was to fix up?
I literally had to do all this: http://imgur.com/a/fhjuf
TOOK ME 1 HOUR TO MOVE THE VILLAGERS
q_q
